fusions.name: Languid Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays tainted water across the 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 water damage to everything in the cone and leaving each target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifts Into the Blood
fusions.desc: A slow bite that deals 25 poison damage, ignoring resistance, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Under Pressure
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Feel It
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, the stacks fade.
